content.short: MPC-powered self-custody wallet with DeFi access, 24/7 settlements, and payment rails.
content.description: io.finnet applies trustless Multi-Party Computation (MPC) to secure digital asset management, removing single points of failure. It lets businesses safely store and transact assets while allocating weighted signing shares among team members to support flexible governance. The platform supports a broad mix of leading and niche blockchains, provides a clean, intuitive dashboard, and offers a seamless API integration. This combination helps enterprises retain control and scale operations without relying on third-party custodians.
content.meta: io.finnet secures digital assets with trustless MPC to eliminate single points of failure. Discover io.finnet and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
